newsitem.title: USA: Muni bond sales total $1.5 bln for Tuesday Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: Muni bond sales total $1.5 bln for Tuesday Nov 19.

text.p: Scheduled competitive and negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $1.55 billion in 55 offerings for Tuesday, Nov 19, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
Competitive sales total $527 million in 35 offerings. The largest is a two-part $250 million San Francisco deal on Tuesday at 1100 EST.
Negotiated sales total $1.02 billion in 20 offerings. The largest issue is a $325 million San Francisco Building Authority issue through BA Securities.
There are 13 issues totaling $514 million on the day-to-day calendar, meaning underwriters have indicated they may price them on Tuesday pending on market conditions.
